easyPrerequisites: You have not cast Black Lotus using Garth.
description:
Activate Garth by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Garth.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Garth.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast Garth from exile by paying {2}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Garth.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Garth.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves equip ability, attaching it to Garth.
Repeat.
